review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped the callers of the fiber/primes-over order isomorphisms in Mathlib. The only cross-proof repetition I found that has real mathematical content is the transfer of a prime q of S over p to a prime q' of the fibre p.Fiber S, which comes with the identity q = q'.comap includeRight and, in two places, QuasiFiniteAt p.ResidueField q'. It occurs three times in this file and once in Unramified/LocalStructure.lean. Each occurrence is only 2–4 lines, so the benefit is modest. The rewrite is a proposal and I have not compiled it. The 533–536 site uses preimageHomeomorphFiber rather than primesOverOrderIsoFiber, so it would need a small variant lemma. Other similar-looking pieces are short or only superficially alike, so I did not report them. These are the surjectivity-via-span_tmul_eq_top steps in of_isLocalization and of_restrictScalars, and the repeated IsJacobsonRing/IsNoetherianRing setup in isClopen_singleton and of_isOpen_singleton. The two rw/simp blocks in Ideal.exists_notMem_forall_mem_of_ne_of_liesOver (544–547 and 554–557) are duplicated inside a single proof, which falls under the "inside a helper" exclusion.

findings.problem: The same fibre-prime transfer is rebuilt by hand in three proofs of this file. Given a prime q of S over p, the proofs pick the matching prime q' of p.Fiber S through an order isomorphism, prove q = q'.comap includeRight via symm_apply_apply (or coe_..._symm_apply plus symm_apply_apply), and then in two of them feed this to QuasiFiniteAt.baseChange to get QuasiFiniteAt p.ResidueField q'. Each copy repeats the explicit ⟨q, ‹_›, ‹_›⟩ or PrimeSpectrum.ext (q.over_def p).symm packaging and the congr($(…symm_apply_apply …).1).symm idiom. The same idiom appears again in Mathlib/RingTheory/Unramified/LocalStructure.lean. The packaging is fragile and obscures that the argument is just 'q is the comap of a prime of the fibre'.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma, placed after QuasiFiniteAt.baseChange, with statement ∃ q' : Ideal (p.Fiber S), q'.IsPrime ∧ q = q'.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ∧ QuasiFiniteAt p.ResidueField q', under hypotheses [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] [QuasiFiniteAt R q]. Proof sketch: take q' := (primesOverOrderIsoFiber R S p ⟨q,_,_⟩).asIdeal. The comap identity comes from (primesOverOrderIsoFiber R S p).symm_apply_apply together with coe_primesOverOrderIsoFiber_symm_apply. QuasiFiniteAt follows from QuasiFiniteAt.baseChange q q' hq'. A smaller companion lemma stating only q = (primesOverOrderIsoFiber R S p ⟨q,_,_⟩).asIdeal.comap includeRight would serve the artinian-instance site (lines 98–100) and the Unramified file, which do not need QuasiFiniteAt. Then lift_residueField_surjective (lines 570–573) becomes an obtain ⟨q', hq'prime, hq', hqf⟩ := … followed by the existing steps; this works if the proof only needs q' abstractly, which looks true since the residueFieldMap step takes hq' and the maximality step takes only QuasiFiniteAt. For the exists_notMem proof, a variant stated for preimageHomeomorphFiber (point e ⟨⟨q,_⟩,_⟩ with its QuasiFiniteAt) would replace the let qF / have : QuasiFiniteAt … block at lines 534–536.
findings.benefit: The fibre/prime bookkeeping is stated and proved once, and the three call sites (and the Unramified one) no longer repeat the symm_apply_apply and ⟨q, ‹_›, ‹_›⟩ plumbing. A reader sees the intended argument: q is the comap of a prime of the fibre, and quasi-finiteness passes to it by base change. Later changes to the fiber isomorphisms are then confined to one lemma.
